discover.label: Discover
discover.description: Find out what exists and decide what to do — literature, benchmarks, direction, and the route to the right skill

write.label: Write
write.description: Produce and diagnose the draft. These read what you wrote and tell you where it breaks; they do not write your claims

verify.label: Verify
verify.description: Check what the draft claims — citations, code, statistics, proofs, notation

toolkit.label: Toolkit
toolkit.description: The machinery around the paper — LaTeX, figures, rebuttals, experiments, cluster, packaging
